tokens_version_restamp: 2.1.0 -> 2.3.0 on 2026-08-04 by /idea-render-mockup. NOT a re-render. Verified: every colour var this render injects matches design-tokens.yaml 2.3.0 in BOTH the light :root block and the prefers-color-scheme:dark block (3400 vars across the 23 re-stamped screens, 0 mismatches). Tokens 2.2.0 and 2.3.0 are additive on the colour and type surfaces a preview consumes. states[].hash was NOT recomputed and is unchanged — this stamp asserts palette currency only, not full input-SHA currency.
nine_chips: All 9 explore chips render with their declared icons and string keys. The ATM Locator chip targets _placeholder:atm-locator (registered deferral, idea-plan.yaml#deferred_routes -> AtmLocatorRoute) and deliberately carries NO accountId arg — the arg-less route drops it, which is the documented gap TC-ACCTDTL-018 records rather than hides.
party_route_note: The Account Holder chip navigates to route `party` while the destination feature is account-holder. The enum case is AccountDetailChip.Party (source truth); the route name is what the nav layer uses.
balances_note: Exactly 3 balance rows. OBIE returns balance types this screen does not model, so an unbounded list would silently render them (TC-ACCTDTL-003).
partial_empty: empty keeps the header card and the Open Banking badge and empties ONLY the balances block — the Euro Wallet account exists and the customer is authorised to see it (TC-ACCTDTL-011).
error_variant: Renders the 401 recoverable variant with Retry. 403 ConsentWithdrawn and 404 NotFound are non-recoverable and must hide Retry while keeping back navigation (TC-ACCTDTL-012..014).
